venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 7/29 (MOD MKZ).** Great start with lots of small groups; 13 Meal Deals all day drove strong food sales ($373). Lots of birthdays — 'Heyyyy Leo season.' Met new industry friends from Soto Soto and Fritti in Inman Park who praised service, vibe, food and bev; crossover from BCB last year. Patty back from TOTC. BOH had great communication; Ntl Chicken Wing Day saw light traction (3 orders). Maintenance: 1st backbar gasket coming loose. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 7/29 (MOD MD / Chef JMS, entered by BC).** Smooth Wednesday, +61% vs target. Slower start allowed cleaning projects; first pop at 9:45pm sustained until close. Difficult food sales ($60) — many guests doing before/after-dinner drinks (Charmer's saw the same pattern). Lots of new and returning guests: first dates, birthdays, celebrations. Served a gracious post-dinner birthday group (Kelly Jo) ~15 min past close. Comps $54.45 / 2.8% (industry, F&F, Neuhoff employee). John Michael excellent in kitchen and on the floor. 86: coasters.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 7/29 (AM Maggie S, PM Maggie H).** Beat target despite rain closing the Garden (Jordan sent home). AM $1,191.72 (67 guests); PM $8,985.30 (~230 guests). Rough, short-staffed night — everyone stretched thin — but hospitality stayed prioritized. Ryan had an excellent first solo serving shift; Kodi a natural behind the bar on only her second shift. Thanks to Jess and Dawson (TRH) for extra hands, and Elexus for coming in last minute after her second job. Kitchen poppin' for a Wednesday with good vibes; heavy prep list passed on. Discounts $402.70, voids $270. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 7/29 (Kyler & Steves, entered by stef).** Slower Wednesday until ~10pm, when a waitlist (up to an hour) filled the floor; room full at 8pm, waitlist started 9pm and completed by 11pm. Date-night heavy; guests building multi-round journeys. Duo city tonight. Celebrated 3 birthdays and 1 anniversary, incl. an 8-top birthday late. Notable guests: Angela celebrating finishing the bar exam, Seth from Batemans, member Sophia Shan +3. Comps $157.91 / 3.6% (service recoveries, industry). Top sellers: Rosalie, Eight Limb, Burner Phone. No no-shows. Breakage: ramekin. Menu count 19.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 7/29 (MOD Gigi, Chef Saleh).** Busy night, +17% vs target — all Marquee ($5,832), no Standing Room or events. Steady start, popped off ~8:30pm; room completely full most of the evening with 5–6 groups on the waitlist — got just about everyone in. Ultimate Tetris: a 9-top, a 12-top, and multiple 8-tops. Lots of sweet industry visitors. Ticket times awesome. Kitchen pushed chips and fries successfully; shoutout Oscar for covering Jorge. Comps $174.76 (industry, DNLs, member Bobby, regular Peter). Favorite: Dayna & Omar drive in from Ventura County because they love D&C. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 7/29 (MOD Marcus).** +21% vs target. Slower start; bar top full by 7pm, first rush 7:15, nearly full room by 8pm, second pickup ~10pm with walk-ins incl. a 21st birthday and a 5-top fresh from the bar exam. 92 guests (68 walk-in / 24 resos). Devan rocked the floor solo with support from Michael; Jada had a fan club at Point; Ian on service, Sasha anticipating behind the bar, Mariah on the host stand. Otakon guests starting to arrive — expect increased traffic from Friday. Comps just $19 (employee discount). Maintenance: curtains coming off rails. No-shows charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Sunny and hot, brief rain after dark
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 7/29 (AM Braden & Lex; PM Justin & Marcus/Drew).** -27% vs target. Health Inspector drop-in first thing in the morning. Quiet morning ($726, 37 guests) — coffee and business meetings; Samantha's final day (legend) helped cover a midday pop. Decent happy hour, then very slow dinner until a random pop at 9:30pm (~7 tables + near-full bar right before kitchen close), gone by 11 — kudos Carla M. for crushing it solo. Sun Club $364 — Skylar's first day solo, busier than yesterday. Hot Eye closed ($0). Kitchen 86'd romanesco and sorbet; both restocked tomorrow (Drew made watermelon sorbet). Note: manager typed date as 2025-07-29 — matched by post time and day of week. No incidents.
